company_name: Taiwan Fairfield Electronic Technology CO., LTD.
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in semiconductor packaging and electronic materials, which are critical for the semiconductor manufacturing process.
summary: Taiwan Fairfield Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. is a high-tech material trading company focused on the sales of imported semiconductor packaging and electronic materials. Their product offerings include conductive adhesives, insulating adhesives, thermal conductive materials, and various potting and sealing compounds, catering to multiple industries including semiconductor packaging and electronic assembly.

regional_presence.Taiwan: The company operates as a high-tech material trading entity within Taiwan, focusing on semiconductor and electronic materials.
